scope: Controls only, without evolution. Mixture residual is mixture-(zero+one)/2 within the same round/job. Holm correction covers all sites, readout treatments, rounds and job-pooled checks; normal approximations, independent shots and stable local response are assumptions. Passing does not certify evolved-state accuracy. Within-job requested order is recorded, but actual dispatch order/timing is not guaranteed. No automatic follow-up hardware execution or mapping selection.
